opc. A 42-year-old man with ascending subacute paresthesias on both legs and arms, symmetric paraparesis and universal areflexia.
opd. A 54-year-old man with cognitive deterioration of a rapidly progressive course in which cranial MRI showed multiple periventricular hyperintense lesions and subcortical lacunae.
